item.title: #2411 - Gavin de Becker
item.itunes:summary: Gavin de Becker is a security expert and the founder of Gavin de Becker & Associates, a firm specializing in threat assessment and protective services. He is the author of several books, including his most recent, "Forbidden Facts: Government Deceit & Suppression About Brain Damage from Childhood Vaccines." Support the show
